sentences.text: CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANOOP KUMAR MENDIRATTA
ORDER % 12.01.2024 Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
Application stands disposed of.

Writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('Cr.P.C.') has been preferred on behalf of the petitioners for quashing of FIR No. 0605/2023 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at P.S.:
Dwarka North, New Delhi.
Learned Standing Counsel for the State/respondent no. 1 and respondent no. 2 appear on advance notice.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 25/01/2024 at 10:11:34
Learned

Standing Counsel on instructions from IO informs that the investigation in FIR No.
605/2023 is still underway and chargesheet is yet to be filed.

The petitioner is stated to have already joined the investigation.

sentences.text: At this stage, since the matter is still under investigation, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the petition without prejudice to his rights and contentions.
Petition is accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn.

ANOOP KUMAR MENDIRATTA, J.
JANUARY 12, 2024/akc
